name: mstack-antigravity-led-review
description: Antigravity coordinator workflow for delivering a plan folder, a list of issues, or one larger task in a repository: Antigravity leads and its writer lanes edit in isolated worktrees (or sequentially on one branch), tracks each item as Open, In progress or Closed, gets read-only review from the other installed vendors that mstack-vendors offers (claude or codex, or a fallback review), integrates, and delivers one pull request with serialized CI. Runs in Antigravity only.
